name: shadow_tier3_obj
description: CEQR Tier 3 shadow projection using a real 3D building model (.obj). More accurate than footprint+height for buildings with setbacks, tapered profiles, or complex massing. Uses pysolar + UTM geometry — same methodology as Tier 3.

building_geojson.description: Building footprint — used to anchor the model in geographic space (lat/lon)

building_obj.description: OBJ 3D model of the building. Assumes Z-up (height), meters, +Y = north by default.

model_rotation_deg.description: Degrees clockwise from north that the model's +Y axis points. 0 = true north. Use 29 for Manhattan street grid.

model_up_axis.description: Which model axis is 'up' (height). Z-up = Rhino/GIS convention. Y-up = SketchUp/OpenGL convention.

model_scale.description: Scale factor to convert model units to meters. 1.0 = meters (default), 0.01 = centimeters (3ds Max), 0.0254 = inches.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction for default analysis dates. NYC uses CEQR representative days.

sensitive_sites.description: Sensitive sites to test for shadow impact. Defaults to NYC Parks dataset.

shadow_polygons.description: Shadow polygon for each analysis time snapshot

sites_affected.description: Sites receiving shadow with shadow entry/exit times and duration per analysis day

summary_report.description: Detailed CEQR-methodology report including building model info

visualization.description: Interactive map showing shadow sweeps per analysis day with sensitive site impact

model_metadata.description: Auto-detected model properties: exporter, up_axis_used, scale_used, native_unit_hint, apparent_height_m. Useful for verifying the model was interpreted correctly.
